svg.title: ContactsManager thumbnail
svg.desc: The Levenshtein edit-distance matrix for ahmed against ahmad, ending in a distance of 1 with one substitution highlighted, fed by the search box of the team build's main window, which has Add Contact and Print All Contacts buttons and a Name list. Below, the two versions: the team build (com.ProGeeks.ContactsManager, six authors, Swing GUI) and my own build (ContactsManager, data layer and search, no GUI yet).
